instruct: A cunning, guarded male voice in his 30s-40s, speaking with deliberate slowness and a hint of theatrical menace — his words are laced with suspicion, as if every syllable is calculated to mislead or provoke. He speaks with a low, gravelly timbre, as though he’s been through too many storms to be anything but weary and wary.
sample_text: Greetings, traveler. What brings you to these lands this day?
